title: Visualise A5 Geospatial Cells
text: geom_a5() takes cells cell aesthetic. cells_rgb() maps red, green blue bands true-colour composite; output already colour, scale needed.  fill scale works. Like geom_sf(), geom_a5() plots longitude latitude default, coord_sf() reprojects cells, NDVI (vegetation index) UTM zone 19S:  Cells drawn polygons large page raster output resolution smaller pixels, plot millions cells costs one thousands. render = "vector" "raster" fixes choice.
code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(s2_santiago, aes(cell = cell, fill = cells_rgb(B04, B03, B02, range = c(300, 2800)))) +   geom_a5() +   labs(title = "Sentinel-2 true colour, Santiago 2023") ggplot(s2_santiago, aes(cell = cell, fill = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04))) +   geom_a5() +   scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Greens", direction = 1, name = "NDVI") +   coord_sf(crs = 32719) +   theme_minimal()

text: cells a5R::a5_cell vector, data frame / tibble containing a5_cell column. path Destination path parquet file. Required. fill Fill colour specification. Default: "Viridis". elevation Column name 3D extrusion, NULL flat. aggregate Aggregation strategy. a5_view() "none" rejected – pyramids make sense aggregated data. Default: "rep_child". lod_step Integer >= 1, gap successive precomputed LODs (used aggregate != "none"). 1 (default) precomputes every level data resolution floor (LOD 2); larger values trade size fewer levels visible popping zoom transitions. lng, lat, zoom Initial map view. title: Build per-cell RGB colours from the first three principal components of an embedding — cells_pca_rgb
text: Convenience helper common embedding-visualisation workflow: stack list-column (matrix) equal-length numeric vectors, run 3-component PCA, percentile-clip scores per channel tame outliers, pack integer RGB suitable a5_view() fill_identity = TRUE. Output handed cells_rgb().

code: cells_pca_rgb(x, clip = c(0.02, 0.98), scale = TRUE, rgb_pcs = c(1, 2, 3))

title: Build per-cell RGB colours from the first three principal components of an embedding — cells_pca_rgb
text: x list numeric vectors identical length (e.g. arrow list-column embeddings) numeric matrix rows = cells columns = features. Must contain NA. clip Length-2 numeric percentile range applied per principal component clip outliers colour mapping. Default c(0.02, 0.98). Set NULL skip clipping. scale Passed irlba::prcomp_irlba(..., scale. = scale). Standardises features unit variance PCA. Default TRUE. rgb_pcs Length-3 signed integer vector specifying PC maps colour channel, red/green/blue order. default c(1, 2, 3) assigns PC1 red, PC2 green PC3 blue. Negative values flip sign corresponding PC, useful PCA components arbitrary sign — e.g. c(1, -2, 3) uses -PC2 green. Must signed permutation 1:3.

title: a5view 0.3.0
text: New geom_a5() draws A5 cells ggplot2 cell column: ggplot(df, aes(cell = cell, fill = value)) + geom_a5(). works coord_cartesian(), coord_quickmap() coord_sf(), combines geom_sf() layers projection, sharing scales, limits graticules. Like geom_sf(), brings default coord_sf() (crs plot’s sf layers, else EPSG:4326), maps keep fixed geographic aspect ratio unless another coord added. ggplot2 sf imported. geom_a5() built large cell sets. One row per cell goes ggplot2, outlines generated draw time. render = "auto" (default) cells smaller three device pixels drawn raster: pixel takes colour cell containing centre, cost depends image size, number cells. render = "vector" render = "raster" force mode. Cells crossing antimeridian split +/-180 degrees. cells_rgb() cells_pca_rgb() return class a5_rgb, integer vector prints hex colours. Mapped fill geom_a5(), draws colours scale legend. a5_view() treats . New dataset s2_santiago: 15,626 resolution-18 cells cloud-free 2023 Sentinel-2 mosaic central Santiago, Chile (blue, green, red near-infrared bands, CC-4.0), examples true-colour composites colour mapping. data-raw/s2_santiago.R rebuilds . README presents a5view visualisation companion a5R, covering ggplot2 interactive maps, rendered examples s2_santiago.
